usage.finalMessage:
I added the `owes <member>` command, and a borrow is now refused when the member owes more than 5.00. The build passes and all 23 tests pass; everything is committed with the report (df9549d).
R3 (staff are never refused) has no code change: it conflicts with R2, L01-R2 and DEC-005, so staff are still refused under those rules until the owners decide.
The report lists two open questions for the owners: that staff conflict, and DEC-006 fine waivers, which the system can't record yet.
OUTCOME: completed
